name: FIREFLIES-SYNC — pull meeting transcripts into data table fireflies_transcripts (daily 17:30 IST + backfill webhook)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query T($fromDate: DateTime, $toDate: DateTime, $limit: Int, $skip: Int) { transcripts(fromDate: $fromDate, toDate: $toDate, limit: $limit, skip: $skip) { id title date duration organizer_email participants transcript_url meeting_attendees { displayName email } summary { overview action_items keywords } sentences { speaker_name text } } }', variables: { fromDate: $json.fromDate, toDate: $json.toDate, limit: 50, skip: $json.skip } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
let n = 0; try { n = $('Shape rows').all().filter(i => !i.json.none).length; } catch (e) { n = 0; }
return [{ json: { synced: n, titles: (n ? $('Shape rows').all().map(i => i.json.title).slice(0, 20) : []) } }];
